info.title: Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Miscellaneous Extensions
info.description:
Miscellaneous service and management extensions for Cisco-IOS-XE-native model.

**Modules covered:** wccp (Web Cache Communication Protocol), vstack (Smart Install), vservice (Virtual Services), ezpm (EasyPerf Monitor), iwanfabric (IWAN/SD-WAN domain), pathmgr (SD-WAN path manager), perf-measure (Performance Measurement), site-manager (SD-WAN site manager), voice-port (Voice Port), interfaces (interface container overview)

**YANG Augments:** Cisco-IOS-XE-wccp, Cisco-IOS-XE-vstack, Cisco-IOS-XE-vservice, Cisco-IOS-XE-ezpm, Cisco-IOS-XE-iwanfabric, Cisco-IOS-XE-pathmgr, Cisco-IOS-XE-perf-measure, Cisco-IOS-XE-site-manager, Cisco-IOS-XE-voice, Cisco-IOS-XE-interfaces

**YANG Model:** [Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Miscellaneous Extensions.yang](https://github.com/YangModels/yang/blob/main/vendor/cisco/xe/17181/Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Miscellaneous Extensions.yang)

get.description:
Retrieve Web Cache Communication Protocol (WCCP) configuration for transparent traffic redirection to cache engines.

CLI equivalent: `show running-config | section ip wccp`

YANG module: Cisco-IOS-XE-wccp

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Limit the depth of returned sub-tree data (RFC 8040 Section 4.8.2). Use 'unbounded' for full depth.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Select specific fields to return (RFC 8040 Section 4.8.3). Example: fields=name;status

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Filter by config state: 'config' (config true only), 'nonconfig' (config false only), or 'all'.

put.description:
Replace WCCP configuration.

CLI equivalent: `ip wccp web-cache`

get.description:
Retrieve Smart Install (vstack) director configuration.

CLI equivalent: `show running-config | section vstack`

YANG module: Cisco-IOS-XE-vstack

**Note:** Smart Install has known security considerations; ensure proper access controls.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Limit the depth of returned sub-tree data (RFC 8040 Section 4.8.2). Use 'unbounded' for full depth.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Filter by config state: 'config' (config true only), 'nonconfig' (config false only), or 'all'.

patch.description: Merge update to Smart Install configuration.

delete.description:
Remove Smart Install configuration (recommended for security).

CLI equivalent: `no vstack`

get.description:
Retrieve the complete interface configuration container. This is a large endpoint covering ALL interface types (GigabitEthernet, Loopback, Vlan, Tunnel, Port-channel, etc.).

**Warning:** This returns a very large payload on devices with many interfaces. Use type-specific paths for targeted queries.

CLI equivalent: `show running-config | section ^interface`

YANG module: Cisco-IOS-XE-interfaces

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Limit the depth of returned sub-tree data (RFC 8040 Section 4.8.2). Use 'unbounded' for full depth.

parameters.name: fields

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Filter by config state: 'config' (config true only), 'nonconfig' (config false only), or 'all'.

patch.description: Merge update to interface container. Use this to add/modify specific interfaces without replacing all.
